data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme investing in the companies of Infrastructure sector
data.investment_objective: The primary investment objective of the scheme is to seek to generate capital appreciation & provide long-term growth opportunities by investing in a portfolio of Infrastructure focused companies. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and equity related instruments relating to infrastructure theme (including units issued by REITs)  :- 80 - 100% Other Equity and Equity related instruments:- 0-20% Debt & Money Market instruments:- 0-20% Units issued by InvITs:- 0-5%
data.exit_load: For redemptions / switch outs (including SIP/STP) within 3 months from the date of allotment of units, irrespective of the amount of investment: 0.5% No exit load shall be applicable on switches from Regular Plan to Direct Plan and vice versa, under the same scheme.
